newsitem.title: NORWAY: Heidrun to begin flowing gas next week - Statoil.
newsitem.headline: Heidrun to begin flowing gas next week - Statoil.

text.p: Gas from the Heidrun field in the Norwegian Sea will begin flowing next week through the 250 km Haltenpipe line to the Tjeldbergodden methanol plant in mid-Norway, Den norske stats oljeselskap said on Thursday.

Haltenpipe is due to carry 70 million cubic metres per year of natural gas, but has an annual capacity of 2.2 billion cubic metres. The gas flow will begin on December 4, Statoil's Status Weekly newsletter said.
The gas will be used as feedstock at the methanol plant, which is due to begin production on April 1, 1997.
